d:
The Warriors defeated the Heat, 120-100, tonight in Golden State. Stephen Curry finished with a team-high 29 points along with 6 three-pointers and 4 assists for the Warriors, while Yaxel Lendeborg tallied 17 points, 8 rebounds, and 6 assists in the game. Davion Mitchell recorded 22 points, 8 assists, and 4 three-pointers. The Warriors improve their record to 6-3 with the win, while the Heat fall to 3-6 for the season.
